problemStatement.formal: Multivariate generalization of Puiseux's theorem: develop multi-variable Puiseux series infrastructure (MultiHahnSeries) and the `IsMultiPuiseuxSeries` predicate, with closure properties.
problemStatement.plain: Generalize the univariate Puiseux series construction to multivariate case via iterated HahnSeries, and prove basic closure properties of the IsMultiPuiseuxSeries predicate.
